purpose: The MEASURED taxi fare schedule for the point-to-point priced mode (issue #49, task 4.7.8; DECISIONS.md 9.76). Clause 2(g) names the Newcastle Transport District an URBAN Area explicitly, settling the urban-vs-country premise (the 4.4 dossier first recorded country-rate-era values).

tfnsw_p2p_fares_order_june_2025.pdf.document: Point to Point Transport (Fares) Order 2025, effective 1 July 2025 (Sally Webb, Deputy Secretary, for TfNSW)
tfnsw_p2p_fares_order_june_2025.pdf.note: Maximum RANK-AND-HAIL fares; booked services (rideshare) are unregulated, so rideshare rates stay literature+swept. The earlier design dossier recorded flagfall $5.17 / $2.61/km - values not in this order; corrected in the dossier in the same change that landed this record.
